concerns.text: FR-004 mandates Type I error 'by shuffling group labels multiple times with a fixed random seed' on the real datasets; T005/T007 estimate it exclusively on simulated null data per the plan's correction. The spec was never amended, so the tasks silently supersede a MUST-level FR — amend FR-004/US-2/SC-002 to record the supersession, or the task list weakens the spec as written.

T006 ('4 transform incl. baseline') and T008 ('including the untransformed baseline') require baseline rows in results, but the schema's transformation enum is only box_cox/yeo_johnson/rank_based with additionalProperties:false — the task deliverable cannot conform to the contract it cites. Add a baseline/none enum value or drop the baseline condition.

T002 writes datasets.csv rows for all ≥50 downloaded datasets pre-filtering, but the contract requires sample_size minimum 30 and missing_pct maximum 10 on every row; rows for datasets that will later be excluded for small N or >10% missing violate the schema. Specify a raw-metadata schema or relax constraints for pre-filter rows.

FR-001 requires datasets from 'UCI Machine Learning Repository and OpenML'; T002 fetches exclusively via sklearn.datasets.fetch_openml with no UCI acquisition path — a silent narrowing of a MUST requirement with no recorded justification.

T003 excludes datasets with 'no continuous variable' and updates datasets.csv with filter_reason, but the enum only permits normal/small_n/missing_too_high/no_group — the no-continuous-variable exclusion required by the spec's Dataset-variable fit assumption cannot be recorded per contract.

Spec edge case says the system must both 'skip the failing transformation' and 'apply log-shift'; T004 implements only the log-shift path, silently choosing one branch of an ambiguous MUST. Record the chosen interpretation (log-shift first, skip only on residual failure) in the spec or task.
